metricTooltips.dashboard_medianScore: Median accountability score across high-confidence rows — small samples are excluded so a couple of events can't swing it.
metricTooltips.dashboard_highRisk: Employees whose accountability score is below 50 at high confidence — the most at-risk performers.
metricTooltips.dashboard_overdueTasks: Distinct live overdue tasks across the org (de-duplicated across co-assignees).
metricTooltips.dashboard_aiRisk: Count of AI-derived risk signals (complaints, risks, delay mentions) extracted from client chats and system events.
metricTooltips.dashboard_lowestScorecards: The lowest current accountability scorecards — worst-performing people first, so attention goes where it's needed.
metricTooltips.dashboard_lowConfidence: How many of these rows have too small a sample to judge confidently — shown for honesty, not as a verdict.
metricTooltips.dashboard_contractsExpected: Total expected contract income for the current month — the sum of every client's monthly target.
metricTooltips.dashboard_contractsActual: Total contract income actually collected for the current month.
metricTooltips.dashboard_contractsAchievement: Actual ÷ Expected contract income for the month, as a percentage.
metricTooltips.dashboard_dueInstallments: Contract installments expected up to the end of this month: this month's installments (any status) PLUS still-unpaid overdue installments carried over from earlier months. Excludes the signing down-payment (sequence 1) and lost/closed contracts. Today it is mostly overdue carryover, not this month alone.
metricTooltips.dashboard_monthlyAchievementBar: Progress toward the month's revenue target — Actual as a share of Expected.
metricTooltips.dashboard_movLost: Contracts lost (not renewed / cancelled) this month.
metricTooltips.dashboard_cntOnTarget: Clients still on target for the month (contract end date in or after this month).
metricTooltips.dashboard_cntOverdue: Clients overdue for the month (contract end date already passed).
metricTooltips.dashboard_cntHold: Contracts currently on Hold (running total, not this month's movement). Like On target / Overdue, this is a current-state count.
metricTooltips.dashboard_topAccountManagers: Account managers ranked by achievement (Actual ÷ Expected) for the month — top performers first.
metricTooltips.dashboard_amAchievementPct: This account manager's achievement: their clients' Actual ÷ Expected income for the month, as a percentage.

metricTooltips.contracts_amExpected: Expected revenue this month for this account manager — the sum of their clients' monthly contract targets.
metricTooltips.contracts_amActual: Revenue actually collected this month for this account manager's clients.
metricTooltips.contracts_amAchievement: Actual ÷ Expected for this account manager, as a percentage. 100% means they hit their full monthly target.
metricTooltips.contracts_bucketOnTarget: Clients whose contract is still on track for the selected month — the contract end date falls in or after this month, so it is not yet overdue.
metricTooltips.contracts_bucketOverdue: Clients whose contract end date has passed relative to the selected month — overdue/at risk and needing renewal action.
metricTooltips.contracts_bucketRenewed: Clients from this month's target list whose contract was actually renewed.
metricTooltips.contracts_bucketLost: Clients from this month's target list whose contract was lost (not renewed).
metricTooltips.contracts_installmentsDue: Scheduled contract installments (payments) falling due in the selected month, listed per client.
metricTooltips.contracts_bucketAccInstOverdue: Clients with an overdue installment on the Account side of the income split (Account-type contracts) — payment is past due.
metricTooltips.contracts_bucketSalesInstOverdue: Clients with an overdue installment on the Sales side of the income split (Sales-type contracts) — payment is past due.
metricTooltips.contracts_movNew: New contracts signed during the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_movRenewed: Contracts renewed during the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_movLost: Contracts lost (not renewed / cancelled) during the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_movUpsell: Existing clients upgraded to a larger contract during the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_movWinback: Previously-lost clients won back during the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_movClosed: Contracts closed/ended during the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_totalExpected: Total expected company income for the selected month — the sum of every client's monthly target. Frozen per month from the sheet pull.
metricTooltips.contracts_totalActual: Total income actually collected for the selected month. Frozen per month from the sheet pull.
metricTooltips.contracts_achievementPct: Company-wide achievement: Total Actual ÷ Total Expected for the month, as a percentage.
metricTooltips.contracts_revenueGap: Total Expected − Total Actual for the month — the revenue still missing to hit target (zero or negative means target met).
metricTooltips.contracts_rosterNew: Current-roster clients on a New contract (status is not closed or lost).
metricTooltips.contracts_rosterRenew: Current-roster clients on a Renewal contract.
metricTooltips.contracts_rosterUpsell: Current-roster clients on an Upsell contract.
metricTooltips.contracts_rosterWinback: Current-roster clients on a Win-Back contract.
metricTooltips.contracts_rosterHold: Current-roster clients on Hold (Hold is stored as the contract type).
metricTooltips.contracts_rosterTotal: Total active clients on the current roster — every client whose contract status is not closed or lost.
metricTooltips.contracts_deptAchievement: Department achievement: the department's Actual ÷ Expected for the month, as a percentage.
metricTooltips.contracts_deptActual: Revenue actually collected this month for this department's clients.
metricTooltips.contracts_deptExpected: Expected revenue this month for this department — the sum of its clients' monthly targets.
metricTooltips.contracts_deptGap: Expected − Actual for this department this month — the revenue still missing to hit its target.
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelOnTarget: Account-department renewals still on target for the month (contract end date in or after this month).
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelOverdue: Account-department renewals overdue for the month (contract end date already passed).
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelSalesDeposit: Sales deposit (عربون) collected toward renewals in the Account department this month.
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelExclRenewals: The renewal target with already-renewed contracts excluded — what is still left to renew.
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelExclLost: The renewal target with lost contracts excluded — the achievable remainder.
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelRenewalGap: Expected renewals − renewed so far (floored at zero) — the renewal shortfall for the month.
metricTooltips.contracts_funnelRenewedRatio: Renewed ÷ Expected renewals for the month, as a percentage. The bar turns green at 70%+, amber at 35%+, red below.
metricTooltips.contracts_clientActiveContracts: Number of active contracts this client currently holds.
metricTooltips.contracts_clientCollected: Revenue actually collected from this client in the selected month.
metricTooltips.contracts_clientExpected: Expected revenue from this client in the selected month (their monthly target).
metricTooltips.contracts_clientExperience: The client's satisfaction tier, mirrored from the رضا العملاء (satisfaction) analysis — not a contract-derived score.
metricTooltips.contracts_teamAchievement: Team achievement: the team's Actual ÷ Expected for the month, as a percentage.
metricTooltips.contracts_teamAchieved: Revenue actually collected this month for this team's clients.
metricTooltips.contracts_teamExpected: Expected revenue this month for this team — the sum of its clients' monthly targets.

help.target: Month-aware delivery status: it compares each contract's end date against the month you've selected (not today). On Target = still within the period; Overdue = the renewal is past due for that month; Sales Deposit / Closed / Lost / Renewed come straight from the contract's stage. Switch the month to see how the same client stood in the past.
help.status: The contract's lifecycle state from the sheet: Active (running), Hold (paused — also stored as the contract type), Renewal Soon (nearing end), Expired, Renewed, Closed or Lost. This is the raw state; the Target column is the month-by-month judgement on top of it.

AccountabilityPage.title: Accountability Engine
AccountabilityPage.subtitle: Who owns each stage, where work stalls, and the evidence behind every number
AccountabilityPage.methodology: Stage dwell is computed in business minutes (Sun–Thu, 09:00–17:00 Riyadh, holidays excluded) from stage history over the last 30 days. Each stage is attributed to its owner: execution to specialists, review to the team manager, sending and client changes to the account manager. A stage still open but already past its SLA counts as a breach. Tasks with no Odoo assignment show as unmeasured and are charged to no one; scores backed by fewer than 5 SLA-measured events render with low confidence.
AccountabilityPage.evidenceRule: Every number on this board opens the evidence list it was built from — click any row.
AccountabilityPage.lowSampleHint: Fewer than 5 SLA-measured events back this number — treat it as an early indication, not a verdict.

help.score: Score = 60% on-time commitment + 40% of open tasks that aren't overdue, blended over the last 30 days of stage history. It's a formula, not a guess — any component with no data drops out and the rest is reweighted.
help.onTime: On-time % = stage steps finished within their SLA ÷ steps that had an SLA rule, over the last 30 days. Small samples (under 5) show neutral, never red.
help.scoreBreakdownNoOpen: This score = on-time {onTime} (no open tasks to weigh overdue against).

scores.title: Operational Health
scores.subtitle: Four composite indices summarizing operational health

scoreTooltips.stability: Overall company-health score (0–100). A weighted blend of Delivery 30%, Quality 25%, Discipline 20%, Productivity 15% (Delivery feeds the composite even though its card now lives in the sections above) plus a 10% risk adjustment (−5 per un-acknowledged escalation, −0.3 per critical overdue task, −6 per at-risk client). Grade: A ≥85, B ≥70, C ≥55, D ≥40, F <40. It's a formula, not a guess.
scoreTooltips.delivery: On-time delivery % (50%) + share of tasks not overdue (30%) + a penalty for average delay (10%) + a penalty for blocked tasks (10%). Computed from the last 30 days. Any signal with no data drops out and the rest is reweighted.
scoreTooltips.quality: Lower rework (30%) + lower rejection rate (15%) + a revision-count penalty (10%) + AI-read client satisfaction from WhatsApp chats (30%). The satisfaction part is a Gemini read; if there are no chats it drops out. (Brief adherence was removed — the AI rarely has the real brief document, so it's unreliable.)
scoreTooltips.discipline: Active-member coverage (30%) + task freshness — share of open tasks touched in the last 7 days (30%) + weekly action volume per person (20%, baseline ~5/person/week) + per-stage SLA compliance (20%, business-hours basis across all SLA-configured stages — the same method as Team Activity / Accountability).
scoreTooltips.productivity: Workload balance (40%) — penalizes both overloaded (>1.75× team average) and underused (<0.4×) members — + 30-day throughput per person (30%, baseline ~12/person/month) + capacity utilization vs an 85% target (30%). Utilization = share of the active roster carrying open delivery work (allocated hours are absent in the source, so load stands in for them).

brief.tagline: Three questions: are we improving, where's the danger, what to do?

brief.q1: Is the company improving or declining?
brief.q1ScoreHelp: The Operational Stability score (0–100) with its letter grade — the same company-health score shown on the dashboard's indicator band. It blends Delivery (30%), Quality (25%), Discipline (20%), Productivity (15%) and a risk adjustment (10%). Grade: A ≥85, B ≥70, C ≥55, D ≥40, F <40.
brief.q1VerdictHelp: Improving / Stable / Declining is decided from week-over-week shifts: on-time delivery % (full weight), overdue-task count (capped, half weight) and weekly completions (capped, light weight). A net move of ±3 flips the verdict; a stability score under 55 blocks an 'improving' reading so a crisis never looks rosy.
brief.q1ChangesHelp: Each pill is a week-over-week change (last 7 days vs the prior 7), taken from the nightly metrics snapshot — green when the shift helps the business, red when it hurts. These deltas are facts from the data; the AI only phrases the summary around them.

brief.riskHelp: How this is flagged: the brief scans live delivery, finance and satisfaction data against fixed thresholds and ranks whatever crossed a line. The numbers above are the actual trigger — AI only phrases the explanation. Severity reflects how far past the threshold it went.

delivery.sectionSubtitle: How reliably you deliver on time and keep work moving
delivery.title: Delivery commitment score
delivery.notEnoughData: Not enough deadline-bearing work yet to score reliably.
delivery.note: Deadlines come from each task's planned date; lateness is measured on tasks completed in the last 30 days. Blocked is estimated from task dependencies.

tips.score: 0–100. How reliably you deliver on time and keep work moving. Blends on-time delivery (vs each task's deadline), the share of your board that isn't overdue, and how late your missed deliveries ran. Shown only with enough deadline-bearing work.
tips.onTime: Of the tasks you completed in the last 30 days that had a deadline, the share delivered on or before it. Deadline = the task's planned date. Compared to your previous 30 days.
tips.overdue: Your open tasks currently past their deadline, out of all your open tasks.
tips.avgLateness: On the deliveries you missed this month, the average number of days they ran late.
tips.lateProjects: Distinct projects you're working in that have at least one of your tasks overdue.
tips.blocked: Estimated: your open tasks waiting on another task (a dependency) that isn't finished yet. Derived from task links, so approximate.
